def raise_from_error(error, params=None):
    if params is None:
        params = {}
    
    error_code = error or params.get('error')
    error_description = params.get('error_description')
    error_uri = params.get('error_uri')
    state = params.get('state')
    
    # Map error codes to exception classes
    error_map = {
        'missing_code': MissingCodeError,
        'missing_token': MissingTokenError,
        'missing_token_type': MissingTokenTypeError,
        'access_denied': AccessDeniedError,
        'invalid_request': InvalidRequestFatalError,
        'mismatching_state': MismatchingStateError,
        'invalid_scope': InvalidScopeError,
        'server_error': ServerError,
        'temporarily_unavailable': TemporarilyUnavailableError,
        'invalid_client': InvalidClientError,
        'invalid_grant': InvalidGrantError,
        'unauthorized_client': UnauthorizedClientError,
        'unsupported_grant_type': UnsupportedGrantTypeError,
        'unsupported_response_type': UnsupportedResponseTypeError,
        'unsupported_token_type': UnsupportedTokenTypeError,
        'invalid_token': InvalidTokenError,
        'insufficient_scope': InsufficientScopeError,
        'consent_required': ConsentRequired,
        'login_required': LoginRequired,
    }
    
    exception_class = error_map.get(error_code, CustomOAuth2Error)
    
    if exception_class == CustomOAuth2Error:
        raise exception_class(error_code, error_description, error_uri, state=state)
    else:
        raise exception_class(error_description, error_uri, state=state)
